spec.assertion: buffApply stat 'atkPct' value 31.83, grouped by expiresFrame: 8-10 activation groups (20s interval over 180s, first-fire phase left as a band), exactly 3 distinct targetSlugs per group, bounded expiresFrame. RED under: all-allies targeting (4 per group), casterAtkPct/highestAllyAtkPct encoding (emits flat ATK, so no 31.83 under atkPct), a continuous window (unbounded expiresFrame), a wrong cadence (10s -> ~18 groups, 40s -> ~4). Plus load-bearing: dropping the buff strictly lowers team damage.

spec.kitLine: start of battle, self: Burst CD down 20s
spec.assertion: milk burst-cast count and milk own total damage are both strictly greater than a run with the burstCdr effect dropped — a 40s to 20s self cooldown must buy extra casts across a 180s fight. RED under: line skipped as defensive, or scoped to allies instead of self (which would move teammates rather than milk cast count). Asserted at the observable level so it is agnostic to whether the encoding is oncePerBattle or a continuous cut.

spec.kitLine: >80% HP, all allies: Crit DMG 11.13% cont.
spec.assertion: buffApply stat 'critDamagePct' value 11.13 with distinct targetSlugs equal to team size and including milk herself; expiresFrame absent/infinite/beyond fight end (continuous). Explicit inertness: zero applies of critRatePct or critRateNormalPct at 11.13 (the Critical Damage vs Critical Rate scope trap). Plus dropping it strictly lowers team damage.

spec.kitLine: per 10 Full Charges: allies Burst CD 2.83s
spec.assertion: team total damage differs from a run with the skill2 burstCdr dropped, and fullBurstStart count never decreases with it present (monotone cooldown relief). RED under: line skipped entirely (identical totals), or keyed to a trigger that cannot fire (e.g. a hit-count trigger that never accrues on a 6-round charge SR). A RED on the not-inert assertion is reported as a genuine scope-lock inertness finding, not a fixture artefact.

spec.kitLine: 367.34% of final ATK as Burst Skill damage
spec.assertion: exactly one burst-bucket damage event per milk burst cast; the payload scales linearly (zeroing atkPct removes delta D, doubling it adds delta D within 2%); fbMajorApplied is never true (burst-cast damage resolves before the FB window opens — verified project fact); no core bonus (kit never says core strike); and every teammate total is byte-identical when the payload is zeroed (pure damage, no rotation/buff side effect). RED under: FB-boosted rider encoding, a core:true hit, a multi-hit/DoT encoding, or a payload that leaks into gauge/rotation.

spec.kitLine: recovers 16.16% of atk damage over 10 sec
spec.assertion: the engine emits no heal/recovery event kind, so the heal is read through the tandem: total buffApply count is strictly greater than a run with the heal effect dropped (crown on-recovery consumer fires on milk emissions), and the per-cast delta exceeds 3 — discriminating a ticks:10 heal-over-time from a ticks:1 instant heal. RED under: the heal skipped as isolation-inert (taxonomy 4), or modelled as one instant tick. Team total is additionally asserted non-decreasing.

fixtures: Single fixture, controlComp('milk', true) — liter (B1) / crown (B2) / milk (carry) / helm (B3), boss Fire, focus on milk; deterministic, no seed. Rationale: milk is Burst I, so the comp must supply a B2 and a B3 for any burst to chain at all — the helm B3 slot is therefore kept ON rather than disabled. Two consequences are handled explicitly: (1) liter is a second B1, so milk own cast count is a rotation outcome and every burst-line group is gated behind an index-free non-vacuity proof (zeroing her burst payload must move HER total); (2) crown carries an on-recovery consumer, which is the ONLY blind channel through which burst line (b) heal is observable, since the engine emits no heal/recovery event kind. Eight hoisted 180s runs: BASE plus seven single-line counterfactuals built with withPatchedOverride (committed JSON untouched), each removing or scaling exactly one kit line so a red counterfactual pins that line rather than aggregate damage.
